notes.title: Corsair`s Madness Prologue: Jungle`s Island RELEASE on 3.02
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43131581/ad38149604c7ee12a28b9683fc5fbdbd50e60608.png[/img]

Hey everyone, it's time to share the release date of the prologue. 

On [b]Friday[/b], [b]3.02[/b], you can finally try out an entire island to explore!
What awaits you as early as [b]TOMORROW[/b]:
[list]
[*] The story's plot
[*] 5 levels
[*] 3 bosses
[*] Playing as a character with two different combat systems
[*] Puzzle solving
[*] Boat battles
[*] Equipment upgrades
[/list]

tags.feature: - Playing as a character with two different combat systems

notes.title: Big news Corsair`s Madness prologue SOON 🥳
notes.content:
[h1][b]What can you find in the prologue?[/b][/h1]

- The beginning of the story 🐚🏴‍☠️🦜
- One entire island to complete 🏝️
- Buying upgrades in the village for the corsair and boat 🌴
- Use a special item - boots with springs! 👟
- 2 Bosses when playing as a Corsair and one as a Possessed ⛵️
- Endurance level to test your skills 🔝
